title: Round-Robin Skip-Ahead Bug (Increments by 2)
bug_signature: UVM_ERROR: [FAIRNESS] Masters 1 and 3 skipped every arbitration cycle
rtl:
always_ff @(posedge clk)
  if (gnt_done) last_gnt <= last_gnt + 2;  // Should be +1
expected_root_cause: The round-robin pointer increments by 2 after each grant (last_gnt + 2) instead of 1, causing every other master (indices 1 and 3 in a 4-master design) to be permanently skipped.
description: The priority pointer advances by 2 each grant cycle instead of 1, causing every other master to be permanently skipped.
failure_log: UVM_ERROR: [FAIRNESS] Masters 1 and 3 skipped every arbitration cycle
success_log: Pointer advances by 1. All 4 masters granted in sequence.
